api = apis.spotify
# Recompute ties for max like_count
unique_song_ids = sorted(set(song_ids))
max_like = None
max_songs = []
for sid in unique_song_ids:
    s = api.show_song(song_id=sid)
    lc = s.get('like_count')
    if max_like is None or (lc is not None and lc > max_like):
        max_like = lc
        max_songs = [s]
    elif lc is not None and lc == max_like:
        max_songs.append(s)

print('max_like', max_like)
print('num_max_songs', len(max_songs))
print('titles', [s.get('title') for s in max_songs])

# If multiple ties, pick deterministically by title
chosen_title = sorted([s.get('title') for s in max_songs])[0]

print('explored_app_apis', {
    'spotify': ['api_docs.show_api_descriptions','api_docs.show_api_doc(show_playlist)','api_docs.show_api_doc(show_playlist_privates)','api_docs.show_api_doc(show_playlist_library)','api_docs.show_api_doc(show_song)','api_docs.show_api_doc(show_song_privates)','api_docs.show_api_doc(show_liked_playlists)','api_docs.show_api_doc(show_liked_songs)','api_docs.show_api_doc(login)', 'login','show_playlist_library','show_song'],
    'supervisor': ['api_docs.show_api_descriptions','api_docs.show_api_doc(show_account_passwords)','show_account_passwords','complete_task']
})

apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=chosen_title)
print('completed with', chosen_title)
